mustFix.problem: At 390 the tub-and-caulk illustration crops to horizontal bars over a blank white slab; the caulk gun and red bead are out of frame, so it reads as a broken image
mustFix.fix: Give the break a mobile composition under 640px (a second portrait SVG, or preserveAspectRatio slice anchored so the gun nozzle and at least 60% of the red bead are in the 390px frame) and drop the band to ~56svh on mobile

elevate.move: Art-direct the drawn plates as one set at every width: a mobile composition for each where the action sits on the right third and the red accent crosses the frame, with the 10:30 break as the hero plate whose bead draws on scroll on phones too

Make the rail the page's clock: its red line fills from 08:00 to 12:00 with scroll, each section's time pill presses in and inks to solid red as the line reaches it, and the footer Punch-out stamp lands at 12:00
